notes: osca is the primary identifier: an OSCA 2024 v1.0 occupation (6 digits) or, for broad careers, unit group (4 digits). oscaSource 'abs' = seen in the ABS OSCA 2024 publication; 'correspondence' = from the ABS ANZSCO–OSCA correspondence table as republished at ozlinks.au. Check both against the ABS data downloads before launch.
anzsco is the ANZSCO 2022 unit group, kept only to join Jobs and Skills Australia's 2025 employment projections, which are published on ANZSCO.

salary is an indicative AUD range for full-time work before tax, excluding super: 'entry' = first year fully qualified, 'experienced' = about 5 to 10 years in. These are Bcome editorial estimates from typical 2025 award and market rates, not JSA or ABS data. Run `npm run data:import-earnings` to add JSA median earnings.
timeToQualify.years is the typical full-time range from finishing Year 12 to the milestone, on the most common route.

profile holds 0–100 occupational profiles on the same dimensions as the Career Profile questionnaire: interests (RIASEC), skill requirements, work values and work environment. They are editorial ratings to be reviewed by careers professionals and, later, calibrated from student feedback.
market holds opportunity indicators. Each field's source is recorded in evidence; 'Bcome editorial estimate' fields should be replaced by the named dataset when available.
riasec (3-letter code), skills, pathways, aiExposure and entryCompetitiveness are editorial judgements for guidance.
